purpose: Map measured automation runtime evidence into the canonical runtime-state-v1 Formula input without embedding a second Formula engine in Runtime Fabric.

dimensions.evidence: typed event identity, source binding, freshness, de-duplication and replay state
deterministic ECA predicate resolution without ambiguous callback-only semantics
owner authority, policy admission, capability scope and Formula decision provenance
due-time drift, queue wait, duplicate suppression, lease/recovery and backlog behavior
handler/workflow completion plus required post-state/Veritas evidence
retry/failover health, provider availability and recovery/fail-safe readiness

observationWindow.rule: 16 comparable automation windows under one workload class, trigger type, authority policy and runtime topology.

calibration.timingLaw: No universal 10ms, 20ms, 50ms or other deadline is canonical until measured for the workload/platform path.

claimBoundary: This adapter defines the observation surface only. It does not define or locally compute F8, and it does not promote simulated triggers or mocked device success to live automation proof.
